recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, textured composition featuring stylized acoustic guitar silhouettes set against a grainy, impressionistic background suggesting water. The aesthetic uses a limited palette with heavy halftone patterns and drop-shadowed serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the solid black silhouette and the pale yellow guitar body
Juxtaposition of sharp typography against a blurry, textured background
Vertical alignment of guitar forms creating a central totem-like anchor
Interaction between organic water textures and geometric graphic shapes
coreInvariants: Heavy halftone grain throughout the image
Drop shadows on all text elements for legibility
Muted, earthy color palette with high-contrast black and white

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two large guitar bodies dominate the center-left and center, with a third horizontal guitar neck in the lower right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central pale yellow guitar body acts as the primary light source and focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-right text, move down the central guitar axis, and settle on the bottom-left text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right side of the frame is relatively open, filled with light-colored water textures to balance the heavy dark silhouettes on the left.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted blue-grey and off-white (background water texture)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black (primary guitar silhouette and shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with extreme value contrast between the black silhouettes and the white highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to black, white, ochre, and slate blue

composition.position: Top right and bottom left corners

treatment.shadow: Heavy black drop shadow, offset down and right

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in two different sizes and positions to create diagonal balance.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy, bracketed serif look and high x-height.
Provides the necessary weight and slab-like serif presence.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an abstract, textured background resembling a river with heavy halftone grain. Center a pale yellow acoustic guitar silhouette next to a solid black acoustic guitar silhouette. Add a horizontal dark guitar neck shape in the bottom right. Use a palette of slate blue, ochre, black, and white.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply lowercase serif text in the top right and bottom left. Use a bold weight, white fill, and a distinct black drop shadow offset to the bottom right.

verificationChecks: Is there a heavy halftone texture across the entire image?
Are there two distinct vertical guitar silhouettes in the center?
Does the text have a prominent black drop shadow?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the yellow accent
mustRedesign: Specific band name and album title text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the halftone pattern is visible in the highlights.
Confirm the drop shadow on the text is sharp and not blurred.
Check that the guitar shapes are stylized and not photorealistic.
Verify the composition feels balanced diagonally.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine abstract musical instrument silhouettes + heavy halftone texture + lowercase serif typography with drop shadows + muted four-color palette.
